inlinePayload.name: kubectl_command
inlinePayload.description: Run a kubectl command against the configured EKS cluster. Use for inspecting pods, deployments, services, logs, and applying manifests. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit_code.

command.description: kubectl arguments without the 'kubectl' prefix. Examples: 'get pods -n 5gc', 'logs deploy/amf -n 5gc --tail=50', 'rollout restart deploy/upf -n 5gc'

inlinePayload.name: ssm_command
inlinePayload.description: Execute a shell command on a managed EC2 instance via AWS Systems Manager. Use for host-level diagnostics and remediation on EKS worker nodes or jump hosts.

command.description: Shell command to run on the instance. Example: 'systemctl status kubelet'

inlinePayload.name: influxdb_query
inlinePayload.description: Query the InfluxDB time-series metrics store using Flux query language. Use for reading 5G NF metrics, counters, and recent samples for alarm correlation.

flux.description: Flux query string. Example: 'from(bucket:"metrics") |> range(start:-5m) |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "open5gs_amf")'
